state.historical_state_freeze: compute once as-of own T_e and store

model.candidate_training_rule: baseline-eligible row plus valid stored morphology state and both valid stored placebo nuisance quintiles; T_e+H<=S

preprocessing.baseline_training_statistics_source: baseline model's own causal historical training rows frozen at UTC ISO-week start S
preprocessing.candidate_training_statistics_source: candidate model's own causal historical training rows frozen at UTC ISO-week start S
preprocessing.transform: for each continuous column, z=(x-training_mean)/training_std using that model's frozen training statistics; apply identical frozen transformation to that model's current-week scoring rows
preprocessing.fit_row_order: ascending canonical RECORD_ID before statistics, matrices, fit, and audit hashes
validity: all required raw and transformed model inputs finite
every standardized continuous training column has finite strictly-positive training standard deviation
design matrix has full required column rank
numpy.linalg.lstsq returns finite coefficients and no fit error
preprocessing.failure_behavior: weekly model UNAVAILABLE; no fallback; current-week scoring unavailable for both candidate and comparator if either frozen weekly fit is unavailable

target.scale: causal trailing-30d median abs H-return with t+H<=T

reference_contract.observation_population: all eligible UTC-epoch-aligned 15-minute decision boundaries, not candidate/trigger records
reference_contract.reference_interval: historical boundaries t in [T-30 calendar days,T) with t+H<=T
reference_contract.failure_behavior: current record UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION for horizon H

metrics.relative_mae_improvement: 1-mean(CAND_AE)/mean(BASE_AE) on exact paired cell support; mean(BASE_AE) must be finite and >0
metrics.bootstrap_statistic: UTC-week block bootstrap distribution of mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT) on exact cell support

placebo.strata: calendar_month_utc(T_e) x side x displacement_quintile x rv_quintile
placebo.nuisance_bin_freeze: each displacement/RV quintile computed once as-of own T_e and stored; no later recomputation
placebo.nuisance_missing_rule: row ineligible for candidate training; baseline-training eligible iff baseline fields and mature target are valid
placebo.training_support: exactly the real candidate training rows; no placebo-only row dropping
placebo.rng: numpy Generator/default_rng seeded deterministically from the full seed-derivation tuple after canonical stratum ordering
placebo.failure_behavior: missing/unavailable/nonfinite placebo-required input or lost real-candidate training/scoring support => placebo gate false / non-promotion; no fallback
placebo.nuisance_reference_causality: include only T_ref with T_ref < T_e; reject T_ref >= T_e
placebo.boundary_assignment: exact boundary p belongs to bin whose lower bound it equals; p=1.0 belongs to Q5

seed_encoding.week_start_S: week_start_ms = integer UTC epoch milliseconds for Monday 00:00:00Z

bootstrap.resample_unit: UTC ISO week; resample whole observed week blocks with replacement

promotion_gate_contract.parameter_rule: same adjacent H pair passes on >=2 distinct W
promotion_gate_contract.year_rule: every selected neighborhood cell positive in >=4/5 years
promotion_gate_contract.selection: lexicographically first by frozen H-pair order then ascending W

primary_positive.support: exact paired current cell RECORD_ID support

material_relative_mae.support: exact paired current cell RECORD_ID support

bootstrap_positive.support: exact paired current cell RECORD_ID support grouped by UTC ISO week
bootstrap_positive.statistic: 2.5th percentile of 2000-replicate UTC-week bootstrap of mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT)

placebo_separation.support: exact real-candidate cell scoring support and exact real-candidate historical training support per frozen weekly fit
placebo_separation.statistic: real mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT) minus 95th percentile of 100 causal-placebo replicate mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT) values

morphology_ordering.support: scored current cell; LOW, MID, HIGH each require non-empty finite BASE_RESIDUAL support

side_stability.support: both frozen direction/side subsets inside the same scored cell; each side requires non-empty finite support plus LOW/HIGH residual support
side_stability.statistic: for each required side independently: mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT)>0 AND median(BASE_RESIDUAL|HIGH)-median(BASE_RESIDUAL|LOW)>0

neighborhood_enumeration.candidate_neighborhood: one adjacent-H pair crossed with exactly two distinct frozen parameter values, producing four cells
neighborhood_enumeration.enumeration_order: frozen H-pair order [30,60],[60,120],[120,240], then lexicographic ascending W-pair

neighborhood_gate_predicates.primary_positive: all four neighborhood cells have per-cell primary_positive=true
neighborhood_gate_predicates.material_relative_mae: all four neighborhood cells have per-cell material_relative_mae=true
neighborhood_gate_predicates.bootstrap_positive: all four neighborhood cells have per-cell bootstrap_positive=true
neighborhood_gate_predicates.placebo_separation: all four neighborhood cells have per-cell placebo_separation=true
neighborhood_gate_predicates.morphology_ordering: all four neighborhood cells have per-cell morphology_ordering=true
neighborhood_gate_predicates.side_stability: all four neighborhood cells have per-cell side_stability=true
neighborhood_gate_predicates.horizon_robustness: for each selected parameter value, both members of the same adjacent-H pair pass all six per-cell predicates
neighborhood_gate_predicates.parameter_robustness: the same adjacent-H pair satisfies horizon_robustness for two distinct frozen parameter values
neighborhood_gate_predicates.year_stability: each of the four neighborhood cells has mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT)>0 in at least 4 of fixed years 2020,2021,2022,2023,2024

promotion_algorithm: enumerate all frozen four-cell neighborhoods in neighborhood_enumeration order
compute the nine named neighborhood gate predicates independently for each neighborhood
a full neighborhood qualifies iff all nine named predicates are literal true
select the first qualifying neighborhood in frozen enumeration order
promotion iff a selected qualifying neighborhood exists AND fail_closed_gate_conjunction over its nine literal gate values returns true
promotion_gate_contract.fail_closed_inputs: missing, unavailable, malformed, nonfinite, errored, empty-required-support, or non-literal-true mandatory evidence => corresponding predicate false and cannot promote
